```{python}
from io import BytesIO
import requests
import polars as pl

URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byui-cse/cse450-course/master/data/housing.csv"

resp = requests.get(URL)
resp.raise_for_status()

df = pl.read_csv(BytesIO(resp.content))

print("Rows, Columns:", df.shape)
print("Column dtypes:")
for name, dtype in df.schema.items():
		print(f" - {name}: {dtype}")

df.head(10)
```

```{python}
# Show ranges (min/max) for numeric columns; unique summary for others
for name in df.columns:
	dtype = df.schema[name]
	dtype_str = str(dtype).lower()
	if "int" in dtype_str or "float" in dtype_str or "uint" in dtype_str:
		minv = df[name].min()
		maxv = df[name].max()
		print(f"{name}: min={minv}, max={maxv}")
	else:
		uniques = df[name].unique()
		n_unique = uniques.shape[0]
		sample = uniques.head(10).to_list()
		print(f"{name}: {n_unique} unique values, sample={sample}")
```
